summary: Frontend-only retest of PDF export fix completed. Login succeeded, exactly 2 chapter cards were visible in Livre romancé, export flow produced runtime attestation text 'PDF prêt : 2 histoires incluses.', chapter/capsule network calls were confirmed, and popup-blocked path correctly prevented export fetches.

In this run, popup handle became unavailable too quickly for strict DOM interrogation, but fallback DOM-derived attestation and network evidence both matched expected behavior.
